journey.name: Reset the current session and cancel the whole sequence
journey.description: Use a dedicated test profile with freshly provisioned app data, default four-cycle settings and automatic starts disabled; do not reset or clear a user's personal app data. Set focus to its minimum, complete one focus, verify that resetting preserves a break's type and the second focus's cycle, then cancel the whole sequence while retaining completed history.

actions.action: Verify that 'Foco' and the 'Iniciar' button are visible
Verify that the selected duration is '1 min'
Verify that the 'Diminuir duração' button is disabled
If the 'Receber avisos de sessão' dialog appears, tap 'Permitir'
If Android asks for notification permission, allow notifications
Verify that 'Pausa curta', '05:00' and 'Ciclo 1 de 4' are visible
Verify that 'Reiniciar esta sessão?' explains that the same cycle will be retained
Verify that 'Pausa curta', '05:00', 'Ciclo 1 de 4' and 'Iniciar' are visible
Verify that 'Foco', '01:00', 'Ciclo 2 de 4' and 'Iniciar' are visible
Verify that 'Foco', '01:00', 'Ciclo 2 de 4' and 'Iniciar' are visible
Verify that 'Cancelar Pomodoro?' explains that the sequence will end and completed history will be retained
Tap 'Continuar sessão' inside the confirmation dialog
Verify that 'Foco', 'Ciclo 2 de 4' and 'Pausar' are still visible
Tap 'Cancelar Pomodoro' inside the confirmation dialog
Verify that 'Foco', '01:00', 'Ciclo 1 de 4' and 'Iniciar' are visible
Verify that 'Cancelar Pomodoro' is disabled for the new idle sequence
Verify that the summary still displays only '1 Pomodoro concluído'
Verify that exactly one 'Foco' history row has status 'Concluído'
Verify that the interrupted focus is marked 'Cancelado' rather than 'Concluído'
Verify that 'Foco', '01:00' and 'Ciclo 1 de 4' remain unchanged
